Callout.Name: Gas Leak Reported
Callout.Message: Strong smell of gas in a residential street.
Callout.Advisory: Residents outside, no ignition source yet.

Script.Line: I can smell it from here. It has been all morning.
The engineers are not coming until tomorrow. I have it in writing.
It is strongest outside number eleven. That is where I would start.

Lines.Approach: You can smell it from the end of the street. Nobody is to touch a doorbell.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
